title: ChatGPT Leads Consumer AI Subscriptions

## ChatGPT Leads Consumer AI Subscriptions


If you already pay for one AI tool, what would make you pay for a second?


We looked at individual subscription receipts for ChatGPT, Claude and Grok across ten markets from January through October 2026. We wanted to see which services people paid for, and how often they paid for more than one.


At[Measurable AI](https://measurable.ai/) , we track consumer spending through transactional e-receipt data — the actual purchase confirmations that land in people’s inboxes after they buy something. It’s one of the most granular, real-time windows into how consumer spending evolves.


## ChatGPT leads in most of the markets, with one exception


ChatGPT reached the largest share of paying users in every market where we show payer reach, except Singapore. Among those markets, its lead was strongest in the Philippines, where 93% of paying users in our panel paid for ChatGPT.


Measurable AI’s Philippines e-receipt panel, January–October 2026. The bars show payer reach across all three services. The Venn diagram uses the subset of payers who paid for ChatGPT or Claude.


Malaysia and Indonesia came next, with ChatGPT reaching 91% of paying users in Malaysia and 85% in Indonesia. In Malaysia, 37% of Claude payers also paid for ChatGPT, while 3% of ChatGPT payers also paid for Claude.


Measurable AI’s Malaysia e-receipt panel, January–October 2026. The overlap grid shows the share of each row’s payers who also paid for the service in the column. Measurable AI’s Indonesia e-receipt panel, January–October 2026. The Venn diagram shows how payers overlap across ChatGPT, Claude and Grok.


In Vietnam, ChatGPT reached 75% of paying users and Claude reached 25%. In Brazil, ChatGPT reached 67% and Claude 34%.


Measurable AI’s Vietnam e-receipt panel, January–October 2026. Bars show payer reach across all three services. The Venn diagram covers only payers who paid for ChatGPT or Claude. Measurable AI’s Brazil e-receipt panel, January–October 2026. The Venn diagram shows how payers overlap across ChatGPT, Claude and Grok.


## Taiwan has the most overlap of the ten markets


Taiwan had the highest share of paying users who paid for more than one AI service, at 9%. About 34% of Claude payers there also paid for ChatGPT.


Measurable AI’s Taiwan e-receipt panel, January–October 2026. The overlap grid shows the share of each row’s payers who also paid for the service in the column.


## Singapore: Claude edges past ChatGPT


Singapore was the exception to ChatGPT’s lead in our panel. Claude reached 53% of paying users and ChatGPT reached 50%. Only 5% paid for both between January and October 2026.


Measurable AI’s Singapore e-receipt panel, January–October 2026. Bars show payer reach across the three tracked services. The circles show which services those payers paid for during the period.


## Grok is growing


Grok remains the smallest of the three paid AI services in our panel, but its share of paying consumers is growing. Its user reach rose in nine of the ten markets we track from January–October 2025 to the same period in 2026. Thailand saw the biggest gain, from about 1% to 8%. Grok also rose from under 1% to about 5% in Taiwan and Malaysia and to 4% in Brazil.


Measurable AI’s Thailand e-receipt panel, January–October 2026. Bars show payer reach across the three tracked services. The overlap grid shows the share of each row’s payers who also paid for the service in the column.


## How ChatGPT and Claude overlap in the United States and Japan ([Schedule demo to unlock](https://blog.measurable.ai/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#caa8bfb9a3a4afb9b98aa7afabb9bfb8aba8a6afe4aba3) )


About 21% of Claude payers in our U.S. panel also paid for ChatGPT, and 7% of ChatGPT payers also paid for Claude in 2026 (January to October). Across the three services, 7% paid for more than one.


Measurable AI’s U.S. e-receipt panel, January–October 2026. The overlap grid shows the share of each row’s payers who also paid for the service in the column. The payer-reach chart is[available in a demo](https://blog.measurable.ai/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#a2c0d7d1cbccc7d1d1e2cfc7c3d1d7d0c3c0cec78cc3cb) .


In Japan, about 14% of Claude payers also paid for ChatGPT, and 10% of ChatGPT payers also paid for Claude. Across the three services, 8% paid for more than one.


Measurable AI’s Japan e-receipt panel, January–October 2026. The overlap grid shows the share of each row’s payers who also paid for the service in the column. The payer-reach chart is[available in a demo](https://blog.measurable.ai/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#224057514b4c475151624f474351575043404e470c434b) .


## Methodology


We track e-receipts from January through October 2026 using direct billing, Apple App Store and Google Play receipts for individual AI plans. Services include ChatGPT Go, Plus and Pro, Claude Pro and Max, and SuperGrok Lite, SuperGrok, SuperGrok Plus and SuperGrok Heavy. Google AI is excluded for its bundled deal. Each market’s denominator is the set of unique users that paid for ChatGPT, Claude or Grok.
